question.text: The element, with atomic number $118,$ will be

solution.text: Electronic configuration of element with atomic number 118 will be $[\mathrm{Rn}] 5 \mathrm{f}^{14} 6 \mathrm{~d}^{10}$ $7 \mathrm{~s}^{2} 7 \mathrm{p}^{6} .$ Since its elctronic configuration in the outer moot or bit (ns $^{2} n p^{6}$ ) resemble with that of inert or noble gases, therefore it will be noble gas element.
